chunks: And Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said:
Fulfilling the need of a believer is better than freeing one thousand slaves, and better than providing one thousand horses in the way of Allah.

key_terms.قَضَاءُ حَاجَةٍ: Fulfilling a need or relieving distress

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual reward for helping a believer according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) elevates satisfying a believer's need above major individual acts of worship like freeing slaves or providing horses, emphasizing the communal and social dimension of faith in Shia ethics. This comparison underscores that relieving distress is not merely charity but a profound spiritual investment that mirrors the divine attribute of mercy, often cited in tafsir as reflecting the ease God grants to those who ease the burdens of others.

en.muhajir-b-ali: Fulfilling the need of a believer is better than freeing one thousand slaves and better than providing one thousand horses in the way of Allah.
